part_A.learner: MLP, one hidden ReLU layer of 32 units, sigmoid output, weight decay 1e-3, full-batch Adam lr 0.01, 300 steps, one shared initialization per state; trained in GPU batches (PyTorch, CUDA)
part_A.primary_endpoints: aleatoric floor of the greedy-oracle gap per dataset
part_A.prediction: registered: (i) the closed-form bracket contains the measured family floor for every dataset; (ii) the floor share of the greedy-oracle gap increases with the noise index across datasets (Spearman > 0); (iii) the p_hat-based H_post agrees with model-free realized hindsight (95% intervals contain zero) in every dataset

part_B.learner: l2-logistic (0.45) as in all earlier studies
part_B.budget: B = 1.03 x envelope of the target_k lowest-risk candidates (supplement-v2 rule); target_k 3, 6, 12
part_B.primary_endpoints: family floor at target_k 12 minus target_k 3, paired by seed, per dataset
part_B.prediction: registered: the aleatoric floor increases with the risk budget: (i) pooled paired difference floor(k=12) - floor(k=3) > 0; (ii) monotone increase over k=3,6,12 in at least 6 of 8 datasets; (iii) bracket coverage at every budget

inference.method: paired one-sample t on independent units; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals and global Holm within each registered family

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim looks; no additional seeds after results
